title: AURA — Always-On Understanding and Real-Time Assistance
summary: AURA is an end-to-end streaming visual interaction framework for continuous video understanding and real-time assistance. It integrates ASR, VLM, and TTS into a unified asynchronous pipeline to process live video at 2 FPS. The system enables proactive QA and multi-response interactions with sub-second latency.
research_notes: Built on the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone and utilizes a dual sliding-window context management system to handle infinite video streams.

evolution.summary: Released in April 2026 as a joint project by Huawei Research and CUHK MMLab. It establishes a new state-of-the-art on the StreamingBench leaderboard, surpassing previous proprietary models in real-time visual reasoning and proactive alerting.
